name: Soul banner
look: Soul banner barrier from dark cultivation fantasy. A vortex of pale ghostly spirits with hollow faces and trailing wisps swirls round the character, dark grey-green smoke between them.
subject: shield

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: spirits pour out of the ground and begin circling, the vortex thickening round the character

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the spirits swirl round and round the character, faces turning as they pass; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow comes from the right; the spirits on that side shriek and lunge outward to the right, mouths open, then are pulled back into the swirl

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the vortex breaks apart and the spirits scatter outward and fade into smoke
